expectations.title: Use the four operations with whole numbers to solve problems

expectations.title: Extend understanding of fraction equivalence and ordering

expectations.title: Solve problems involving measurement and conversion
expectations.description: Solve measurement conversion problems, understand angle measurement, and represent data.

expectations.title: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes
expectations.description: Draw and identify lines and angles and classify shapes by properties.
